name: Anivia
notes: Glacial Storm is toggled on once at the start of the fight and left running for the rest of it: turning it off both forces its post-effect cooldown and only grants one extra tick, so continuous uptime is always better.

Only a fully-formed tick of Glacial Storm (its fourth tick onward, once the 1.5 s growth phase finishes) applies the Iced mark that doubles Frostbite; the three half-value growth ticks do not, matching the wiki's wording that only a 'fully formed' storm applies it.

Glacial Storm's damage ticks are read to stay on the 0.5 s TickRate even once empowered (at 300% value), since that is the only tick-rate value in Riot's data; the 0.25 s figure in the tooltip text only describes the empowered slow's refresh rate, not a faster damage tick.

Flash Frost's passthrough hit and its manual recast explosion are both modeled as landing together at the cast, with no travel time, since the fight guarantees every skillshot hits regardless of position; both apply/refresh the Iced mark and both count as separate ability activations for on-cast effects (Spellblade, Muramana, Eclipse).

Frostbite's very first cast is delayed by Flash Frost's own 0.25 s cast time so it lands after Flash Frost's Iced mark goes up rather than before it, matching the proposed opening of Q into E; after that, Q and E are each recast independently on cooldown.
Crystallize (W) deals no damage of its own (its knockback is only a 0-damage proc) so it is never cast and contributes nothing to the rotation; it is leveled last.
Rebirth (passive) is purely defensive (a death-save plus resistances while reviving) and is not modeled in this damage-only fight.
Mana, including Glacial Storm's per-second drain, is not modeled: a level-16 six-item Anivia is assumed to have enough mana access to sustain continuous casting for the fight's duration.

attack: Anivia's damage is entirely from her abilities and a well-played Anivia casts rather than auto-attacks, so attack.never is set; the engine makes no basic attacks and attack-speed/on-hit items get no value here, which is intended.
